facts.fact: The Minister of State Modernisation told a parliamentary committee on 16 November 2023 that drawing up the diploma setting the interoperability references (referenciais) for public-administration systems is a legislative-reform project for 2024; the document does not say drafting has begun.
facts.system: diploma on interoperability references of public-administration systems

note: Planned 2024 diploma only; no adoption or compulsion stated. Parent to judge whether a planned elaboration counts as draft.
